message.text:
q05.

**8** — AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, InstanceService, MemoService, ShortcutService, UserService

Each is declared in its own file under `proto/api/v1/`:

| Service | File |
|---|---|
| `AIService` | `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` |
| `AttachmentService` | `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto` |
| `AuthService` | `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` |
| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` |
| `UserService` | `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto` |

The count is corroborated by the generated Connect bindings in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/`, which contains exactly eight `*.connect.go` files matching one-to-one with the services above. The tenth proto file in the directory, `common.proto`, declares only shared message types and no service — hence 8 services from 9 `.proto` files. Note that `IdentityProviderService` is the one case where the service name doesn't track its filename (`idp_service.proto`).
